messages.text:
**Recommend retaining the tracker and reclaiming space for calorimetry first.** Coordinated directly with System Architect.

| Option | Tracker outer radius | Service reserve | ECal barrel entrance |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Recommended | 1.140 m | 1.140–1.240 m | 1.300 m |
| Deferred expansion study | 1.340 m | 1.340–1.440 m | 1.500 m |

Both retain a proposed 0.060 m ECal-facing gap. Capacity remains unverified.

Keep tracker half-length **3.150 m** and initially retain ECal endcap entrance **3.650 m**, preserving forward interface space.

Larger tracker radius does **not** establish better η=4 coverage. At unchanged length, it reduces the angular reach of an outer cylindrical timing surface. Expansion requires a separate layer/material/timing study.

No files changed; only geometric arithmetic performed.
